rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an aspect, feature, or respect of something.

example.english: Battery life is one aspect where this phone performs quite well.
example.traditional: 呢部手機喺電量方面做得幾好。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai2 din6 loeng6 fong1 min6 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the aspect is a distinct part or component rather than a perspective.

example.english: The hardest aspect of this job is having to deal with customers all day.
example.traditional: 呢份工作最難嘅部分係要成日對住客。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 gung1 zok3 zeoi3 naan4 ge3 bou6 fan6 hai6 jiu3 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 haak3

rows.note: Use this for an aspect considered specifically as a viewpoint or angle of analysis.

example.english: From an environmental aspect, taking the MTR is better than driving.
example.traditional: 從環保角度睇，搭港鐵好過揸車。
example.jyutping: cung4 waan4 bou2 gok3 dou6 tai2 daap3 gong2 tit3 hou2 gwo3 zaa1 ce1
